rubric: Equivalent supported wording is accepted. Check units, conditions, uncertainty and support; numeric substring matching is insufficient. These rubrics are not an implemented evaluator.

cases.question: How many unused annual leave days can I carry over, and when must I use them?
required_facts: Up to 5 unused days may carry into the next calendar year.
They must be used by 31 March of that year, after which they expire.

cases.question: Does three consecutive working days of sick leave require a medical certificate?
required_facts: Yes: the published threshold is more than 2 consecutive working days.
forbidden_claims: A certificate is required for every single day

cases.question: What is the normal office attendance rule for a new employee during their first four weeks?
required_facts: New employees work from the office every working day during their first 4 weeks.
forbidden_claims: Every new employee may automatically work remotely 2 days per week

cases.question: Is there money to help me set up a desk at home?
required_facts: Hybrid and remote employees receive a one-time home-office stipend of USD 300.
It must be claimed through the expense system within 90 days of joining.
forbidden_claims: All employees qualify regardless of arrangement

cases.question: For a full-time employee with three years of continuous service who is past probation, what are the annual entitlement and monthly accrual?
required_facts: 21 working days per calendar year.
1.75 days monthly accrual.
forbidden_claims: 30 days for three years of service
A statement of the employee current available balance

cases.question: For a full-time employee with exactly ten years of continuous service, what are the annual entitlement and monthly accrual?
required_facts: 30 working days per calendar year for 10 years or more.
2.5 days monthly accrual.

cases.question: What nightly hotel limit does the travel policy list for Tokyo?
required_facts: Tokyo is on the high-cost city list.
The listed limit is USD 250 per night.
forbidden_claims: A booking or reimbursement is personally approved

cases.question: Is a receipt required for a single USD 25 expense?
required_facts: Yes: a receipt is required for any single expense above USD 20.
forbidden_claims: Receipts are required only above USD 25

cases.question: How many annual leave days do I personally have left today?
required_facts: The supplied policy passages cannot establish a personal current balance.
A trusted HR balance lookup would be needed.

cases.question: May employees work abroad from any country for twenty working days without asking anyone?
required_facts: No: up to 20 working days per calendar year requires direct manager and HR approval requested at least 3 weeks in advance.
Restricted countries are not permitted; the supplied fixture does not include the restricted-country list.
Core hours in the home time zone still apply.

cases.question: I have an expense from 60 days ago. Does this policy definitely guarantee reimbursement?
required_facts: No definitive reimbursement determination is supported by this excerpt.
It says submit within 30 days and says more than 90 days will not be reimbursed.
It does not resolve the 31–90 day interval; do not invent a yes/no rule for that interval.
forbidden_claims: All claims up to 90 days are guaranteed
Every claim after 30 days is categorically rejected

cases.question: What is the capital of France?
required_facts: No supported answer is available from this policy fixture.
